info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Product Broker Agreement Management API
info.description: The Product Broker Agreement Management API enables the efficient updating of agreements between brokers and agencies. This API primarily handles the modification of existing product broker agreements, allowing businesses to adjust terms as necessary. Typical consumers include financial institutions and brokerages seeking to streamline their agreement processes. By leveraging this API, developers can ensure that their systems reflect current terms swiftly and accurately.

patch.summary: Update an external agency's product broker agreement.
patch.description: This endpoint allows for the updating of a specific product broker agreement associated with an external agency. By providing the necessary details, you can modify agreements that are already in place, ensuring that terms and conditions reflect current arrangements.
